caption: Global Metadata. 112 BPM, C minor, polished electronic pop with a live drum feel; intimate verse, wide anthemic chorus, half-time bridge, full-band final chorus, short tail. Modern loud master with real dynamics, wide stereo, analogue warmth, tape saturation on the drum bus, plate reverb with short pre-delay. Vocal Details. Single female lead, warm alto with breathy close-mic verses opening to full chest voice on the chorus; octave double and a low third on chorus lines only; breaths kept in. Arrangement. Primary: felt piano and round sub bass. Secondary: live drums with rimshot backbeat, muted electric guitar arpeggios, bowed cello pad, analogue synth choir far back. Groove sits slightly behind the beat with real space in the verses.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Glass and neon on the avenue
I am learning how to breathe again
Every window holds a stranger
Every stranger holds a light

[Chorus]
And I will carry it
All the way to morning
I will carry it
Even when the city sleeps

[Verse]
Rain is writing on the pavement
Something only I can read
All the years I spent apologising
Washing off into the street

[Chorus]
And I will carry it
All the way to morning
I will carry it
Even when the city sleeps

[Bridge]
No one told me
That the quiet could be kind
No one told me
I would like what I would find

[Chorus]
And I will carry it
All the way to morning
I will carry it
Even when the city sleeps

[Outro]
Glass and neon
Glass and neon
title: Glass And Neon
